name: Octop
description: 连接自托管或云端的 Octop 实例，列出专家、发起或继续专家对话，并处理工具审批。
description_zh: 连接自托管或云端的 Octop 实例，列出专家、发起或继续专家对话，并处理工具审批。
description_en: Connect to a self-hosted or cloud Octop instance: list experts, start or continue expert conversations, and handle tool approvals.
examples_zh: 列出我的 Octop 实例上可用的专家
让 Octop 里的写作专家帮我起草一份周报
继续刚才和 Octop 专家的对话
Octop 专家请求批准执行命令，帮我处理这个审批
examples_en: List the experts available on my Octop instance
Ask the writing expert on Octop to draft a weekly report
Continue my previous conversation with an Octop expert
An Octop expert is requesting command approval, help me handle it
